lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A pattern of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns of 3 to 6 units, with the highest concentration and largest diameters observed in the upper-right quadrant of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of lower pixel intensity segment the flank horizontally, creating a grid where high-luminance spots are bounded and occasionally bisected by these dark vertical demarcations.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal ridge-like feature is visible in the upper quadrant, displaying a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity light on top to deeper shadow beneath the fold.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 12-15 dark, elongated fusiform silhouettes, exhibiting lower pixel intensity than the surrounding water, are aggregated near the ventral-lateral boundary of the visible flank.
